fixed: The coins raining on your head were too small to see. They are bigger and there are more of them.
The lump of coal was lost on the dark floor. It is half as big again.
The tag on the fuel can lay over the host, and the tag on the bread hung down over the table. The can stands clear of her, and a thing on a table wears its tag on top.
The table of bills appeared from nowhere halfway through. It stands in the room from the start of this part.
The tag under the Earth (8.3 billion people) was hidden by the table, then by the envelope. The Earth now hangs over the table, clear of both.
The wind and the rain were shown with nobody there. The host now stands in the field and points them out.
notes: The table of bills is in the room from this part on; it was not there in part 1.
The top of the Earth in the shot about sharing the bill slips a little under the counter in the corner.
Two shots run a little over four seconds (the coins raining, and the look at the real bills).
The wind and the rain are shown outside in a field at night, with the host there; the script has them at the window of the room.
No music in this part, as the script asks: a faint room tone and a small bell on each tag. Claude cannot hear; the listening is Biku's.
